lanes.title: contract/receipt
lanes.scope: Project-local readiness rendering and local test-process receipt contract only.
deliverables: strict readiness checker and generated Markdown
atomic local receipt runner and verifier

exit_criteria.description: Matrix/render checker, atomic receipt runner/verifier, and all L1 unit and negative tests pass.

non_claims: A local receipt is only a local test-process outcome.
This lane does not establish Gate A, Gate B, native security, or installation readiness.

lanes.title: provenance/namespace
lanes.scope: Closed P0/P1 provenance classes and writer-owned project-relative namespaces.
deliverables: synthetic fixture non-promotion and namespace-negative tests

exit_criteria.description: Closed classes and root checks pass.
Synthetic promotion, link/reparse, reserved-lab, collision, and tamper cases fail closed.

non_claims: Synthetic fixture material cannot be promoted by a digest, lab binding, or passing parser test.
The generic P0/P1 verifier does not read or rewrite artifacts/labs.

lanes.title: routing audit
lanes.scope: Explicit agent-authored route decisions with no provider invocation or configuration change.
inputs: approved observed-local receipt references when present

exit_criteria.description: Decision writer/verifier binds candidate, policy digest, and optional local receipt references.
No raw prompt, credential, provider call, or effective-model claim is retained.

non_claims: A declared route decision does not observe provider execution.
A route audit does not change provider or model configuration.

lanes.title: P2 disposition
lanes.scope: This repository's P2 disposition only; it is not a cross-repository policy or authorization grant.

exit_criteria.description: The P2 stop record validates and links L1-L3 state.
Any reopening has the listed project-local evidence and necessary explicit authorization.

non_claims: The stop record is not consent, a schedule, a live-goal change, or a provider invocation.
The stop record does not authorize a Windows retained experiment.
This matrix is project-local Pre-Genesis planning and does not establish readiness.
Gate A remains incomplete and Gate B outcome remains not established.
No native security verification, installation, provider-effective route, or external observation is claimed.
No P0/P1 generated receipt or model-route record is committed by this matrix.
